checks.title: [Khia canh VARIANT] Xoa printarea dang gan cho variant: variant.printarea_id giu nguyen null; lien ket cu duoc GIU LAI duoi dang ORPHAN ROW trong variant_printareas (VI TRI DU LIEU CONFIRMED qua KB-096; bug-vs-accepted VAN MO, xem CONF-CHK-04-009-001)
checks.precondition: Co 1 printarea dang duoc gan cho it nhat 1 variant (qua Custom Printareas - xem CHK-05-011)
steps: Tao 1 printarea, gan no cho 1 variant (qua Custom Printareas, sau khi bat toggle 'Custom variant's printarea')
Xoa printarea do qua nut X
Quan sat UI: printarea co bien mat khoi bang Printareas khong; cell 'Custom Printareas' cua variant lien quan sau khi RELOAD co ve 'No printareas' khong
Quan sat API: doc field flat variant.printarea_id (truoc va sau khi xoa); doc rieng bang variant_printareas de tim row lien quan toi printarea vua xoa (lap lai nhieu lan doc cung 1 session)
checks.observation_point: UI: printarea trong bang + cell 'Custom Printareas' sau reload. API: gia tri field variant.printarea_id + trang thai row trong bang variant_printareas
checks.expected_result: CONFIRMED_EXPECTED cho CA 2 phan (UI va vi tri du lieu), theo PO xac nhan (2026-09-14, dap lai CONF-CHK-04-009-001: 'B dung, gia tri lien ket cu nam trong variant_printeraes') + bằng chứng đã xác nhận (KB-096), cong voi xac nhan truoc do cua PO ve phan UI (2026-09-13, KB-074). HANH VI DA XAC NHAN (khong phai ket luan dung/sai theo thiet ke): Phan UI - sau khi xoa printarea dang duoc it nhat 1 variant tham chieu, printarea bien mat NGAY khoi bang Printareas; cell 'Custom Printareas' cua variant lien quan tro ve 'No printareas' SAU KHI RELOAD trang. Phan API/DB - field FLAT variant.printarea_id GIU NGUYEN gia tri null (khong doi truoc/sau xoa - kien truc thuc te KHONG dung field nay de luu lien ket); TUY NHIEN bang RIENG variant_printareas VAN GIU LAI 1 row lien ket cu duoi dang ORPHAN ROW tro toi printarea da bi xoa (vd {id:23540, printarea_id:13989} sau khi xoa printarea 13989) - row nay KHONG duoc don dep tu dong, xac nhan qua 3 lan doc lai doc lap cung 1 session (gia tri khong doi). Day la VI TRI DU LIEU THAT SU (bang nao giu gia tri cu) da duoc PO XAC NHAN LA FACT (KB-096) - CHI dung lam oracle cho cau hoi 'du lieu nam o dau', TUYET DOI KHONG duoc suy dien tu day rang orphan row nay la 'dung theo thiet ke' (accepted) hay 'bug can fix'. Cau hoi bug-vs-accepted VAN CON MO (xem conflict CONF-CHK-04-009-001, muc 'needs') - KHONG duoc tu chon phia trong bat ky bao cao/ket luan test nao dua tren check nay.
risk_refs: CONF-CHK-04-009-001 (VI TRI DU LIEU da RESOLVED qua KB-096, PO xac nhan 2026-09-14; cau hoi RIENG BIET 'day co la bug can fix hay accepted behavior' VAN UNRESOLVED - xem needs)
data-integrity-orphan (variant_printareas khong tu don dep sau xoa printarea) - CHUA ket luan bug hay accepted, chi la fact ve vi tri du lieu
